message.content:
Design a comprehensive sprint-based implementation plan for ConvertScan (CROBOT) — an AI-powered CRO audit SaaS.

## CURRENT STATE (from codebase exploration)

**What's FULLY built:**
- Auth: Supabase Auth + Google OAuth + email/password (AuthContext.tsx, Login/Signup pages)
- CRO Scanning Pipeline: analyze-url edge function (1,120 lines) — screenshot → AI vision + text analysis → PageSpeed → scoring → save
- 7-pillar scoring with page-type-specific weights
- Dashboard: KPI cards, charts, recent scans (665 lines)
- Audit Report: Full 7-pillar display, findings, severity badges (1,001 lines)
- Billing: Dodo Payments (checkout, webhook, portal) — 3 plans (Free 3 scans, Pro 50, Agency 500)
- Admin Panel: 9 pages (users, scans, billing, support, system, audit log, feature flags, integrations)
- Email: Resend integration (welcome, scan complete, weekly digest)
- PDF Export: Client-side jsPDF
- Landing Page: 11 components with Framer Motion animations
- 47 shadcn/ui components installed
- 25 hooks (scan, billing, dashboard, admin)
- 6 Supabase migrations with RLS

**What's PARTIALLY done or missing:**
- Analytics integrations (GA4, Hotjar, Clarity, Search Console) — DB table exists, no OAuth flows
- White-label reports — not implemented
- REST API access — not implemented
- Chrome extension — not started
- Monitoring/alerting — basic hooks only
- Score history/trending — no time-series tracking
- Competitive benchmarking — no competitor URL comparison
- Team workspaces — not implemented
- Sentry/error tracking — not integrated

**Stack:** React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4 + shadcn/ui + Supabase (auth+DB+storage+edge functions) + Dodo Payments + Resend + Claude API

## THE DOSSIER VISION (from CRObotDossierV3.jsx)

The dossier outlines a 19-phase roadmap. Key features planned:
1. Instant URL audit (DONE)
2. AI copy improvement generator (partially in prompts)
3. Mobile UX scoring (in vision analysis)
4. Trust signal detector (in text analysis)
5. Priority scoring system (scoring.ts has this)
6. Competitive benchmarking (NOT built)
7. PDF/white-label reports (PDF done, white-label NOT)
8. API access (NOT built)
9. Integrations (Zapier, Slack, Chrome extension) — NOT built
10. Score history + improvement tracking (NOT built)
11. Agency/white-label features (NOT built)
12. AI copy rewrite engine v2 (NOT built)
13. Interactive audit report (partially done)
14. Analytics admin dashboard (partially done)

**Pricing from dossier:**
- Starter: $29/mo (5 audits)
- Growth: $49/mo (25 audits)
- Pro: $99/mo (unlimited)
- Agency: $199/mo (everything + white-label + 10 seats)

**Current pricing in code:**
- Free: 3 scans/month
- Pro: $49/mo (50 scans)
- Agency: $199/mo (500 scans)

## DESIGN GOALS

**UI/UX Philosophy:**
- Modern, light, clean — NOT dark/heavy
- App-like feel — smooth transitions, instant feedback
- Trust-building — mature, professional, sharp
- Addictive — gamified progress, score improvements, streaks
- Mobile-first responsive
- Current design system: Inter font, indigo primary (#5B5FC7), HSL CSS variables, soft shadows

**What attracts CRO customers:**
- Instant gratification (paste URL → see score in 60 seconds)
- Actionable insights (not just data — specific fixes with copy rewrites)
- Progress tracking (score improvement over time)
- Professional reports (PDF, shareable links)
- Competitive context (how you compare to industry)
- Priority system (what to fix first for max impact)

## SPRINT PLAN REQUIREMENTS

Design 6-8 sprints (2 weeks each) covering:

### Sprint 1: Foundation & Polish
- Fix pricing alignment (current 3-tier → dossier 4-tier: Starter $29, Growth $49, Pro $99, Agency $199)
- UI polish pass: loading states, error states, empty states consistency
- Dashboard redesign: make it the "home base" — score trends, action items, gamified progress
- Onboarding flow for new users (first scan guided experience)

### Sprint 2: Core Feature Enhancement
- AI copy rewrite engine — show "Current → Suggested" for headlines, CTAs, value props
- Score history & trending — track scores over time per URL
- Re-scan capability — scan same URL again, show before/after comparison
- Finding implementation tracker (mark fixes as done, re-audit)

### Sprint 3: Competitive & Premium Features
- Competitor URL comparison (audit 3-5 competitor URLs side-by-side)
- Industry benchmarking (aggregate scores by vertical)
- Enhanced PDF reports (branded, executive summary)
- Shareable report links (public read-only URLs)

### Sprint 4: Team & Agency Features
- Team workspaces (invite members, shared audit library)
- White-label reports (custom logo, colors, domain)
- Client portal (separate login per client)
- Bulk URL processing (CSV upload)

### Sprint 5: Integrations & API
- REST API (POST /audit, GET /reports, webhooks)
- Slack integration (/crobot audit <url>)
- Chrome extension (audit current tab)
- Zapier/webhook integration

### Sprint 6: Growth & Retention
- Email sequences (onboarding drip, weekly digest, win-back)
- Referral program (agency → client referrals)
- In-app notifications (score improved, new fix available)
- SEO landing pages for key terms

### Sprint 7: Analytics & Monitoring
- Score monitoring (weekly re-audits with alerts)
- Integration with GA4/Search Console for conversion data
- Admin analytics dashboard enhancement
- Error tracking (Sentry) + performance monitoring

### Sprint 8: Polish & Launch Prep
- Performance optimization (bundle size, lazy loading)
- Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Security audit
- Product Hunt launch preparation

For each sprint, specify:
1. Exact files to create/modify
2. Database migrations needed
3. Edge functions to create/modify
4. UI components to build
5. Hooks to create
6. Testing requirements
7. Definition of done

Also specify the UI/UX design decisions for key screens:
- Dashboard (home base)
- Scan flow (URL entry → progress → results)
- Audit report (findings display)
- Score comparison (before/after, competitor)
- Team workspace
- Settings/billing

Keep it production-grade, not prototype-grade. Every sprint should ship something users can see and use.

1	# ConvertScan (CROBOT)
2	
3	AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.
4	
5	## Stack
6	- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
7	- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions + Storage)
8	- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
9	- **Billing**: Dodo Payments (subscriptions)
10	- **Email**: Resend
11	- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
12	- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway
13	
14	## Architecture
15	- SPA (Vite) — no SSR. All backend logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime)
16	- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth + email/password)
17	- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase with RLS on every table
18	- Storage: Supabase Storage for screenshots
19	- Edge Functions: Deno runtime, import from URLs (not npm)
20	
21	## Key Files
22	- `src/App.tsx` — routing, AuthProvider wrapping
23	- `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — auth state management
24	- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — core scan submission flow
25	- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — report display with 7 CRO pillars
26	- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — KPI cards, recent scans, charts
27	- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — all scan CRUD operations
28	- `src/hooks/use-scan-results.ts` — pillar results queries
29	- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — Dodo Payments checkout/portal
30	- `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` — client-side PDF generation
31	- `src/lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client
32	- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits
33	- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — scoring algorithm, color mapping
34	- `src/types/index.ts` — all TypeScript types
35	- `src/types/database.ts` — Supabase database types
36	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/` — main scan orchestrator
37	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — AI system prompts
38	- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/scoring.ts` — scoring engine
39	- `supabase/functions/pagespeed/` — Google PageSpeed integration
40	- `supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/` — Dodo Payments checkout session
41	- `supabase/functions/dodo-webhook/` — Dodo Payments event handler
42	- `supabase/functions/dodo-portal/` — Dodo Payments customer portal
43	- `supabase/functions/send-email/` — Resend email service
44	
45	## Database Tables
46	- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
47	- `scans` — audit scan records
48	- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
49	- `integrations` — third-party service connections
50	
51	## The 7 CRO Pillars
52	1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
53	2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
54	3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
55	4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
56	5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
57	6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
58	7. Page Performance (9% weight)
59	
60	## Pricing Tiers
61	- Free: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
62	- Pro ($49/mo): 50 scans, all suggestions, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring
63	- Agency ($199/mo): 500 scans, white-label, multi-client, API
64	
65	## Commands
66	- `npm run dev` — start dev server (port 8080)
67	- `npm run build` — production build
68	- `npm run lint` — ESLint
69	- `npx supabase functions serve` — local edge functions
70	
71	## Environment Variables
72	### Frontend (.env.local)
73	- VITE_SUPABASE_URL
74	- VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
75	
76	### Supabase Edge Functions (secrets)
77	- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
78	- PAGESPEED_API_KEY
79	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_URL
80	- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_API_KEY
81	- DODO_API_KEY
82	- DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
83	- DODO_PRODUCT_PRO_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
84	- DODO_PRODUCT_AGENCY_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
85	- RESEND_API_KEY
86	- SITE_URL
87	
88	## Conventions
89	- All components use shadcn/ui from `@/components/ui/`
90	- Toast notifications via `sonner`
91	- React Query for all server state
92	- Supabase RLS enforces data isolation — no manual auth checks needed in queries
93	- Edge functions return JSON with CORS headers
94	- Findings stored as JSONB arrays in scan_results
95	- Score colors: green (70+), amber (40-69), red (0-39)
96	
97	## Agent Hub (UI-only feature)
98	- `src/pages/AgentHub.tsx` and `src/pages/AgentWorkspace.tsx` are UI demo pages
99	- They intentionally use `MOCK_AGENTS`, `MOCK_AGENT_TASKS`, `MOCK_AGENT_MESSAGES`, `MOCK_AGENT_ACTIVITY` from `src/lib/mock-agents.ts`
100	- The agent engine (`src/lib/agent-engine.ts`) is a client-side simulation — no real backend calls
101	- Do not replace mock data in agent pages without a real backend implementation to replace it with
